sources.fullCitation: “Der neue Tauber-Film.” Das Kino-Journal (Vienna), 20 December 1930, p. 12. Österreichische Nationalbibliothek / ANNO.
sources.title: Der neue Tauber-Film
sources.researchNote: The production notice announces the forthcoming Richard Tauber sound film directed by Max Reichmann. It names Paul Dessau for musical direction, Fritz Rotter for the song texts and Dr. Kaper for the song music, and states that filming was to begin at Tempelhof on 2 January.
